unit-economics.why: Detailed token-level cost breakdown with explicit assumptions (model, token counts, retry rate, RAG, infra markup) producing a fully-loaded $0.007–$0.01/draft figure before any pricing recommendation.

structure-choice.why: Explicitly evaluates four alternatives (pure flat, pure usage-based, outcome-based, unlimited) with specific objections to each, then selects tiered seat add-on with included allowance + overage and justifies each element of the choice.

margin-distribution.why: Runs complete margin tables across p25/p50/p90/p99 for both Starter and Pro tiers, showing GM% at each percentile and flagging the one borderline case (Pro p90 at 58%) with a mitigation suggestion.

cost-guardrails.why: Specifies hard-metered allowance, auto-billed overage in 100-draft blocks, soft-limit warnings at 80%, and references a hard fair-use cap (truncated but clearly intended).

value-wtp-crosscheck.why: No explicit cross-check against value delivered to the buyer (e.g., time saved per draft, agent labor cost offset) or next-best alternative pricing. Pricing is derived purely from cost-plus with a target GM%, not anchored to WTP.

cost-trend-sensitivity.why: Explicitly notes −30–40%/yr inference cost trajectory and states the structure must flex to accommodate it, acknowledging this in the margin constraints table.
